content: Ligand 1 is the pyrimidin-4-yl probe; atom 0 is its azine methyl, the anchor. I have varied the cap's ring size four ways and found it completely activity-neutral, but I have never varied the cap's attachment carbon - every version has a CH at that position. Putting the surviving methyl there makes it a 1-methylcyclopropanecarboxamide, a quaternary centre that forces the carbonyl out of the plane it currently prefers and crowds the amide. If activity holds, the cap really is inert and only its ring matters for SA; if it drops, the cap's geometry is doing something after all, which would be the first evidence that it is more than a spacer. I pair it with the 4-chloro azine so the rest of the molecule is my best-measured configuration. The cost is about 14 Da and some lipophilicity, so QED will fall to roughly 0.85 and this will not beat 2.30 on Phi - but with activity capped, a clean read on the last unvaried position is the better use of the call.
